scope: Concrete native view construction/events, bounded stale-safe binding, window-local selection/progress models, own-window insets/fullscreen and read-only window-metric policy, catalog/domain presentation operations, native entry-shell composition. NOT a WebView facade or completed browser.
invariants: No business DB/runtime/session opened by locked startup; no debug/first-click/source-unconfigured unlock
Native controls forward exact captured opaque refs/catalog revisions, not arbitrary ID lookup/latest-selection fallback; every late event repeats current issuing permit and native window binding
Selection/progress/view cancellation is only window presentation, never authority, task whole-chain end, source consent, granted sensor access or persistent deletion
Bound at most64workspaces/50tabs; old listeners/bindings retire on rebind, unbind clears sensitive labels/input and animations
Progress display only owned native-reported numbers; no guessed5percent/timer-to-completion or URL-as-document identity; page stop not job/login/storage completion
Own-window styling/insets only, no global rotation/timeout/roles/volume/DND changes; trim/visibility never stops legitimate service media
Dialog text/information not owner authentication or source-force consent; unknown submission retains own pending window until actual dismissal
Actual Android View/Window/dialog/metric and full UI/Gecko integration must remain separately pending; model HOST tests and API compile do not qualify layout parity
integrationPending: Actual verified epoch/startup Native domain factory, MainWindow lifecycle/TargetReferences/ActorContext/current policy/finite permissions/Gecko callbacks/checkpoint restore; Root remains unconfigured/locked. No site/device validation implied.
